task: Layer 3 perception gate, iteration 4 (ticket 06 item 4, Slice B): score the galaxy variation law on the perception rubric - arms 2-4 with drawn sweep and derived pitch, scale length, bulge fraction/radius/flattening, bar, halo, dust and colour age per galaxy, plus a real size range 0.5e20..9.0e20 m (18x) that drives framing, the wheel ceiling, legibility and exposure per galaxy. Chair-owned; no external handoff before the 8.
commit: uncommitted tree at gate time (16 modified + 4 new files, base 93eaf89); the gate ran on the working tree
verdict: 8/10, SHIP. Target met: all twelve galaxies read as galaxies and are visibly different in arm count, winding, colour and bar. The defect that made the first cut a pinwheel of radial spokes - ridge/trough 1.3 on v1/4, v1/6, v1/9, four of twelve drawing spokes - is fixed at its cause (sweep drawn, pitch derived as sweep x scaleLengthFraction) with the population minimum now 4.99 and a regression test that pins the sweep bounds and the derivation. Two-arm galaxies at the m=2 calibration are unchanged (ridge/trough mean 8.10 across 12 seeds; lit px 196,942; arm window 58.1% / 114 components; 4K arm edge 33.9% / 66 blobs >=80 px), so layer-3 calibration is not disturbed. Size is real: every framing, ceiling, legibility and exposure path reads the galaxy's own radius, and a fixed-camera pair shows a 52 px and a 196 px disc at identical camera coordinates. The gate scored 8, not 9, because three named imperfections remain (uniform star sprite size at 4K 1:1; halo clumps at the top of the draw range; lane:arm width 2.33 at the thin-arm end), and 9 requires exactly one.
